newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy money market sees rates falling.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy money market sees rates falling.

text.p: Italy's money market sees market rates coming down over the next month, a study by Bocconi University research arm Igier showed on Friday.

On a one-month horizon, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 7.68 percent, just 18 basis points above the current official discount rate, against an actual market close of 7.94 percent on Thursday, the day on which Igier based its study.
One week ago the implicit overnight rate was seen standing at 7.78 percent, while one month ago it was seen at 8.11 percent.

On a three-month timeframe, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 7.27 percent from 7.44 percent seen a week ago. On a one year horizon the implicit overnight rate is forecast at 6.58 percent from 6.90 percent a week ago. On a two year horizon, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.97 percent from 7.33 a week ago.

The spread between the implicit Italian overnight rate and the implicit German overnight rate in two years' time, considered a good indicator of market confidence in Europe's economic and monetary union, today stands at 213 basis points, from 236 bps seen a week ago and the 266 bps forecast a month ago.
